title: flshell push anti-fusion negative replicates on fresh seeds 6 and 7: merge/split 0.82-0.84 (gamma 10) and 0.80-0.86 (gamma 30) vs 0.68-0.85 at gamma 0; touching gliders share one merged shell
summary: Ran the finding's world.py unchanged with gamma_S 0, 10 and 30 on fresh seeds 6 and 7 (t=800, one noise patch). merge/split: gamma 0 0.68/0.85, gamma 10 0.84/0.82, gamma 30 0.86/0.80, so the shell push does not reduce fusion. Division continues but is weaker with the push: persistent splits 7/9 (gen 5/5) at gamma 0, 5/5 (gen 4/3) at gamma 10, 5/3 (gen 3/3) at gamma 30. g30/seed6/sheet.png shows the reason the finding gives: where two gliders touch, their set-point shells merge into one envelope around both (t~350, t~766), so nothing pushes them apart.
